items.title: Asia's investment spending to hit $16 trillion by 2030 as industrial capex broadens: Report
items.summary: Asia's investment spending is projected to surge to $16 trillion by 2030 from $11 trillion in 2025, according to Morgan Stanley. Broader industrial investment in manufacturing, energy and defence is expected to drive nearly half the increase, outpacing AI and semiconductor spending. The investment boom could lift Asia's investment-to-GDP ratio to 32% and boost its global export share.
